card.name: Start of split medical terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a medical term that is split into parts, such as h in hemosiderin, hemothorax or hemorrhage, A in APL or AML, and Sh in Shigellosis. It appears in adverse-event and indication lists.

modes.label: Blood-term starts
modes.description: The h that begins hemo- words such as hemosiderin, hemothorax and hemorrhage.

modes.label: Disease abbreviation or name starts
modes.description: The first letter or letters of a disease name or acronym, such as APL, AML or Shigellosis.

modes.label: Start of small or stool
modes.description: A piece like small or St that begins a longer word such as smallpox or Stool.
modes.example: disseminated vaccinia infections after<< small>>pox immunizations
